usage.intro: Mar kasta oo Mon courrier wax weydiiyo Claude (akhrinta warqad, ka jawaabidda wadahadalka, tarjumaadda), qaddarka qoraalka la farsameeyay (tokens) iyo qiimaha la qiyaasay halkan ayaa lagu qoraa. Fariin ama magac lama kaydiyo.

usage.budget.help: Ugu badnaan waxa la isticmaali karo bishii, doolar ahaan (lacagta Anthropic ku qaado). Digniin ayaa soo baxda 80%. Bannaan u daa haddii aanad xad rabin.

num.releasedToast: Lambarka waa la sii daayay. Qofka waa loo sheegay.
num.blockBody: Fariin ka timaadda lambarkan mar dambe lama qaban doono, waxbana uma diri doonno, xusuusinadu ay ku jiraan. Hadhow waad furi kartaa.
conv.guardHeld: Lambarkan waxaa hakiyay ilaaliyaha spam-ka: fariimihiisa cusub lama qabto.
conv.guardBlocked: Lambarkan waa la xiray: fariimihiisa waa la iska indha tiraa.
login.codeWrong: Koodhkani ma shaqaynayo. Sug kan xiga oo mar kale isku day.
login.locked: Isku day badan. Mar kale isku day {n} daqiiqo kadib.
signup.tooMany: Codsiyo badan muddo gaaban gudaheed. Fadlan mar kale isku day hadhow.
signup.doneTextEmail: Iimayl ayaan kuu soo dirnay: fur xiriirka ku jira si aad u xaqiijiso ciwaankaaga. Kadib isuduwe ayaa ansixin doona akoonkaaga.
verify.title: Ciwaanka iimaylka waa la xaqiijiyay
verify.text: Mahadsanid. Hadda isuduwe ayaa eegi doona codsigaaga. Waad geli kartaa isla marka la ansixiyo.
tfa.title: Xaqiijinta laba-tallaabo
tfa.on: Shidan: gelitaanku wuxuu weydiinayaa koodh app-kaaga.
tfa.off: Ku ilaali akoonkaaga koodh 6 god ah oo lagu daray furaha sirta.
tfa.required: Waa lagama maarmaan xuquuqda maamulaha (mutadawaciinta, kharashka, diiwaanka gelitaanka…).
tfa.banner: Xuquuqdaada maamulaha waa hakad ilaa xaqiijinta laba-tallaabo la shido.
tfa.step1: Ku rakib app xaqiijin (Aegis, FreeOTP, Google Authenticator…).
tfa.step2: Iskaan garee koodhkan, ama taabo badhanka taleefankan, kadib qor koodhka uu muujiyo.
vol.emailUnverifiedHint: Qofkani weli ma gujin xiriirka iimaylkiisa. Taas kadib ayaad ansixin kartaa codsiga.
vol.reset2faBody: Isticmaal tan haddii qofku lumiyay taleefankiisa. Meel kasta waa laga saarayaa, waana inuu dejiyaa app cusub. Marka hore hubi cidda uu yahay (wicitaan, kulan).
sandbox.location: Dir goob (taada, ama Paris République haddii la diido)
places.notLocatedHelp: Ciwaanka lagama helin khariidadda: goobtu waxay ku jiraysaa liiska maalinta, laakiin looma soo jeedinayo dadka wadaaga goobtooda. Hubi ciwaanka (lambar, waddo, magaalo).
assoc.title: Ururro
assoc.intro: Urur kastaa wuxuu leeyahay maamulayaal u gaar ah: waxay ansixiyaan isdiiwaangelinta mutadawaciintooda, waxayna ku casuumi karaan xiriir.
assoc.createHelp: Ka raadi diiwaanka rasmiga ah si isdiiwaangelinta dooranaysa ay u gaarto maamulayaashiisa.
assoc.name: Magaca ururka
assoc.exists: Ururkani horey ayuu ugu jiraa Wilson.
assoc.noAdmin: Weli maamule ma jiro: codsiyadu waxay u gudbaan maamulayaasha Wilson.
assoc.addAdminHelp: Qofku wuxuu ku biiraa ururka. Wuxuu ansixin karaa isdiiwaangelinta, casuumi karaa mutadawaciin, wax ka beddeli karaa xuquuqdooda, ururkan oo keliya.
assoc.removeAdminBody: {name} wuxuu ahaanayaa xubin ka tirsan {association} laakiin mar dambe ma ansixin karo ama ma casuumi karo. Fadhigiisa waa la xiray.
join.title: Ku biir Wilson
join.intro: Waxaa ku casuumay {name}. Akoonkaagu wuu firfircoonaanayaa isla marka la sameeyo.
join.introNoAssociation: Waxaa lagugu casuumay inaad ku biirto Wilson. Akoonkaagu wuu firfircoonaanayaa isla marka la sameeyo.
join.invalid: Xiriirka casuumaaddani mar dambe ansax maaha (horey loo isticmaalay, la buriyay ama wuu dhacay). Weli waad diri kartaa codsi.
join.doneText: Ku gal iimaylkaaga iyo furaha sirta.
inv.title: Casuun mutadawac
inv.intro: Xiriir hal mar la isticmaalo, ansax ah 7 maalmood. Qofku wuxuu ku biiraa {name} isagoon sugin ansixin.
inv.introGlobal: Xiriir hal mar la isticmaalo, ansax ah 7 maalmood. Qofku wuxuu helaa akoon firfircoon isagoon sugin ansixin.
inv.label: Yaa loogu talagalay?
inv.readyBody: Adigu u dir qofka (WhatsApp, SMS, iimayl). Hal mar oo keliya ayaa la muujiyaa: hadda koobi samee.
inv.shareText: Ku biir {name} Wilson si aad u caawiso dadka aan taageerno:
inv.emptySub: Ku samee xiriir “Casuun” kuna dir qofka.
vol.permsScoped: Sanduuqyada cawlan waxaa beddeli kara kaliya maamulaha Wilson.
vol.memberLosesAdmin: Beddelidda ururka waxay ka qaadaysaa doorkiisa maamulaha.
